authorization.intent: Every OpenCode Go model gets exactly 3 scored attempts at its max tier under the main max-tier campaign's frozen settings (prompt-v2). Infrastructure and quota failures do not count; they are rerun as linked retries. Order: attempt 1 for every missing model first, then attempts 2, then 3.
authorization.go_key_rule: At most ONE attempt at a time per Go key (OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY, _1, _2, _3; controller-wide leases). Each key is probed with one tiny request before use; a usage-limit probe or a QUOTA attempt closes only that key, which re-probes after 30 min.
authorization.service_restoration: forbidden on Paris, except the precedent resolver watchdog: systemd-resolved is restarted when its RSS exceeds 400 MiB (same helper and rule as the OAuth repeats launch)
